name: GRAB HOLDINGS LIMITED
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Grab Holdings Limited Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-06), cover page: the securities registered under Section 12(b) are Class A Ordinary Shares (Nasdaq: GRAB) and warrants (Nasdaq: GRABW) — the Nasdaq listing is the ordinary share itself; no ADS class is registered and the company has no depositary/ADS program for the US listing (listing directories likewise carry GRAB as 'Class A Ordinary Shares', not an ADR)
ads_ratio.reason: Per-share figures are per Class A ordinary share and the Nasdaq price is per the same Class A ordinary share, so the conversion is 1 ordinary share per traded share; the engine's ADS_RATIO_MISSING flag is generic to 20-F filers.

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Grab Holdings Limited Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-06), cover page: the securities registered under Section 12(b) are Class A Ordinary Shares (Nasdaq: GRAB) and warrants (Nasdaq: GRABW) — the Nasdaq listing is the ordinary share itself; no ADS class is registered and the company has no depositary/ADS program for the US listing (listing directories likewise carry GRAB as 'Class A Ordinary Shares', not an ADR)) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: SBC exceeds cash generation (OCF - capex is positive; SBC consumes it).
